TEXT.English: In this mod, the Huns represent the early steppe confederation north of China. They appear around 210 BC with a cavalry army, a small steppe homeland and no advanced siege technology. Their Power of the Steppe lets damaged mounted units heal up to 25 HP by pillaging an enemy improvement, once per unit per turn during war. Roads do not grant healing. If they survive until the scheduled Mongolian appearance, Mongolia is permanently replaced by a one-time Hunnic army matching the Mongolian starting combat force. This grants no settlers, workers or technologies. If the Huns have fallen, Mongolia appears normally.

TEXT.English: Modu Chanyu leads the Huns. His forces favour mobile warfare on the northern Chinese frontier. Existing Mongolian artwork represents this leader.
